title: Agnostic Sequential Rationality
abstract: arXiv:2608.25731v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agnostic sequential equilibrium (ASE) is a refinement of sequential equilibrium that does not force on the players a single, arbitrary belief system. In addition, whereas sequential equilibrium assumes the players' beliefs to be fully consistent (a notion that is based on perturbations of strategies), ASE employs a novel, simpler and local concept of strong consistency between strategy profiles and off-equilibrium beliefs, which is applicable to a large class of dynamic games, including games with a continuum of actions. In the last respect, the new solution concept is similar to perfect Bayesian equilibrium. It is shown that a strategy profile in an imperfect-information extensive-form game with perfect recall is an ASE precisely when it is a sequential equilibrium with every fully consistent belief system. ASE is generalized by the set-valued solution concept of agnostic sequential polyequilibrium, which allows leaving the players' act

translated_abstract: 不可知序列均衡（ASE）是对序列均衡的一种精炼，它不强迫玩家接受单一的、任意的信念系统。此外，序列均衡假设玩家的信念完全一致（这一概念基于策略的扰动），而ASE采用了一种新颖、更简单且局部的强一致性概念，用于策略配置与均衡外信念之间，适用于一大类动态博弈，包括具有连续动作空间的博弈。在这一点上，新解概念类似于完美贝叶斯均衡。研究表明，在具有完美回忆的不完美信息扩展式博弈中，一个策略配置恰好是ASE，当且仅当它在每个完全一致的信念系统下都是序列均衡。ASE通过集值解概念“不可知序列多均衡”进行推广，该概念允许保留玩家的行动。
tldr: 本文提出了不可知序列均衡（ASE），一种不依赖单一信念系统的序列均衡精炼，采用局部强一致性，适用于连续动作博弈，并推广为不可知序列多均衡。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Agnostic Sequential Equilibrium (ASE), a refinement of sequential equilibrium that avoids imposing a single belief system, uses local strong consistency, applies to games with continuous actions, and generalizes to agnostic sequential polyequilibrium.
